title: ALMA Observations of the Extraordinary Carina Pillars: HH 901/902
question: What are the molecular outflows, dusty disks/envelopes and pillar kinematics and masses of the HH 901/902 protostellar objects in Carina, and how fast will the pillars photo-evaporate?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 50 uJy/beam; line rms 6.5 mJy/beam km/s

what.value: Jet inclination ~20 deg to plane of sky

evidence.quote: where $\theta$ is the inclination angle taken to be 20$^\circ$ (cite: rei2013; rei2014)
The Tr 14 cluster has an UV luminosity $(Q_H)$ of $2 \times 10^{50} \mathrm{\ photon\ s^{-1}}$ (cite: sb2008)

what.value: Dust mass opacity 0.015 cm2/g at 1.3 mm

evidence.quote: Assuming a dust mass opacity ($\kappa_\nu$) of 0.015 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ (taking a dust-to-gas ratio of 100) appropriate for these wavelengths (1.3 mm) (cite: Oss1994)

recipe.method: CASA calibration, CONCAT of C43-6 and C43-3, CLEAN/TCLEAN with natural weighting

recipe.goal: Fit continuum sources and derive disk+envelope dust mass
recipe.method: Gaussian fit to robust=0.5 map; optically thin isothermal dust mass equation
assumptions: kappa=0.015 cm2/g, beta=1.2, Td=50 K (30 K for source B), dust-to-gas 100, D=2.3 kpc

recipe.goal: Outflow and pillar gas masses from C18O/CO
recipe.method: LTE mass equation with opacity correction, inclination correction for outflow; energy, momentum, force
key_parameters: Tex=50 K, X(H2/CO)~1e4, mean molecular weight 2.8, inclination 20 deg

recipe.method: EUV mass-loss rate formula, timescale = pillar mass / rate

evidence.quote: we obtained a deconvolved size of 0.49$''$ $\pm$ 0.03$''$ $\times$ 0.33$''$ $\pm$ 0.03$''$ with a PA of 100$^\circ$ $\pm$ 7$^\circ$
an integrated flux of 6.8 $\pm$ 0.4 mJy Beam$^{-1}$
of the disk and envelope system associated with HH 901 of about 0.1 M$_\odot$
an integrated flux of 6.5 $\pm$ 0.7 mJy Beam$^{-1}$
has a flux density of 38 $\pm$ 2.0 mJy Beam$^{-1}$
so the $dv_{real}$ = 16 km s$^{-1}$ and the mass is 10$^{-3}$ M$_\odot$
we obtain a value of 1.5 $\times$ $10^{-5}$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$
the pillar will be photo-evaporated in around 10$^5$ years

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, masks, cell and image size
Which continuum/moment velocity ranges and clip levels
How the continuum beta=1.2 was derived
Which archival calibration (pipeline or manual) was used
Exact method for average intensities and areas in mass equation
How 0.1 Msun and flux uncertainties were propagated
missing_for_reproduction: Exact intensity/area values behind mass equation
score_reason: Data are public and the analysis is simple with stated assumptions, but imaging details and extraction choices are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple recipe with numeric masses and fluxes, though imaging details are partly missing.
